from pathlib import Path
p = Path('astropy/io/ascii/rst.py')
text = p.read_text()
old = '''    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(delimiter_pad=None, bookend=False)

    def write(self, lines):
        lines = super().write(lines)
        lines = [lines[1]] + lines + [lines[1]]
        return lines
'''
new = '''    def __init__(self, header_rows=None):
        super().__init__(
            delimiter_pad=None, bookend=False, header_rows=header_rows
        )

    def write(self, lines):
        lines = super().write(lines)
        n_header_rows = len(self.header.header_rows)
        lines = [lines[n_header_rows]] + lines + [lines[n_header_rows]]
        return lines
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('old snippet not found')
p.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
print('patched')

args.summary: Updated `astropy/io/ascii/rst.py` so the RST writer accepts `header_rows` like the base `FixedWidth` writer. `RST.__init__` now forwards `header_rows` to `FixedWidth.__init__`, and `RST.write` now places the RST border/separator line around all configured header rows (previously it hard-coded `lines[1]`, which only worked for a single header row).
